clips.title: The story
paras: Forsaken rogues seek Fenwick Thatros along the shores of Lordamere Lake. His head is proof of his execution, claimed on orders passed down from Lord Varimathras.

Mennet Carkad acts from the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity on urgent intelligence from dreadlord Varimathras. Fenwick Thatros, a hostile undead leader, has established a foothold near the decaying docks along Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest. To keep him from rallying hostile undead against the Forsaken, Carkad sends promising Deathstalkers to find and kill him, then bring back his head as proof.

For Deathstalker operatives, bringing Fenwick's Head to Carkad is a trial beyond collecting a bounty. The severed head proves a rogue's skill in infiltration and assassination. Success opens the way to deeper, more specialized instruction in the shadow arts from Forsaken masters.
